sources.entry: Sonar - Native music player with synchronized lyrics and menu bar and notch playback controls. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/can4hou6joeng4/Sonar) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Sonar is a native SwiftUI music player for iOS 17+ and macOS 14+ that plays local audio files with synchronized lyrics and can also search and stream NetEase Cloud Music tracks.
summary.what_it_does: Plays local MP3, FLAC, M4A and WAV files offline, reading ID3 tags, artist, album and embedded cover art, and auto-matching same-named .lrc lyric files. Online search covers NetEase Cloud Music only (other sources are temporarily disabled), with lyrics, artist and album browsing, and playback via a native client plus ChKSz. Playback tries quality tiers from master down to 128K for the same song. Local playlists are stored with SwiftData and can be backed up as JSON, and public NetEase playlists can be imported by link or ID with preview and deduplication. The Mac app puts a library panel in the menu bar and a player in the notch area (a top capsule on non-notch displays); the iOS app adds a Now Playing widget with shuffle.
use_cases: play local music files offline on Mac or iPhone
view synced LRC lyrics for local songs
search and stream NetEase Cloud Music tracks
import a public NetEase playlist into a personal library
back up and restore playlists as JSON
control playback from the macOS menu bar or notch
how_to_run: Mac: download SonarMac.dmg from GitHub Releases and drag it into Applications, or run ./scripts/package-mac.sh to build DMG and ZIP
If Gatekeeper blocks the app: xattr -cr /Applications/SonarMac.app
Build from source: open Sonar.xcodeproj in Xcode, select the Sonar or SonarMac scheme, and run
iOS: the published IPA is unsigned and must be signed with your own personal signing tool or Xcode provisioning before install
Optional: set SONAR_CHKSZ_KEY at build time for ChKSz features
notable: Native SwiftUI apps for iOS and macOS sharing one library and playback state
Mac menu bar panel and notch-style top player with favorites synced across surfaces
Playback quality fallback from master through Hi-Res, lossless, 320K and 128K
Public NetEase playlist import with preview and deduplication before merge
No JavaScript/LX source scripts shipped; NetEase access is handled natively
caveats: Only NetEase Cloud Music is enabled; QQ, Kugou and other sources are disabled and their favorites are marked unavailable
Mac release is ad-hoc signed and not notarized, so Gatekeeper may block first launch; the iOS IPA is unsigned and needs your own signing
Streaming depends on third-party services, and availability and quality vary by track and account
